Introducing The All-New ZXi RKT Woods
RAW POWER, PURE SOUND
Engineered for power with a finely tuned acoustic signature.

settings.title: VR-Titanium
settings.text: A brand-new titanium alloy that adds silicon to the composition dramatically increases design freedom. Leveraging VR-Titanium enables more overall flex from the face through body, greatly heightening initial ball speed.

settings.title: i-flex
settings.text: A refined face thickness pattern maximizes energy transfer at impact. The strengthened internal i-FLEX structure allows for a thinner face design, generating faster ball speed.

settings.title: Variable Roll Design
settings.text: This new roll design maximizes accuracy on misses across the face and helps suppress hooks on high-toe strikes.

settings.title: Rebound Frame
settings.text: Rebound Frame amplifies energy transfer at impact by utilizing two flex zones, instead of just one, increasing power, ball speed, and, ultimately, shot distance.

settings.title: RKT Face
settings.text: RKT Face is not just one thing. It is the perfected sum of our most advanced ball speed, flex, and roll technologies. Each one re-tuned to perform better and enhance the others—with the common goal of creating our fastest and most accurate face ever.

settings.title: Tour-Driven Chasis
settings.text: Through rigorous prototyping and on-tour testing, R&D engineers aligned with pro staff to create significant shaping updates on every ZXi RKT clubhead that fit the eyes and performance needs of the best players in the world.

settings.title: Acousticore
settings.text: Our completely new ACOUSTICORE chassis feature AI-optimized internal rib structures, precisely tuned to refine the acoustic character of every ZXi RKT model. The result is a crisp, controlled sound at impact.

settings.title: Player-Focused Adjustability
settings.text: Different weighting designs on each model plus adjustable hosels allow for fine-tuning launch and spin performance for every player.

settings.title: Carbon Crown
settings.text: All drivers use a strong, lightweight carbon crown, positioning mass low and maximizing COR.
SELECT YOUR ZXi RKT DRIVER
The all-new stable of Srixon ZXi RKT Drivers features three purposely crafted models built with explosive speed to meet the long game needs of tour players, professionals, and amateurs alike.

settings.heading: ZXi RKT LS Driver
settings.text: The ZXi RKT LS Driver's advanced low spin profile is built for aggressive players seeking distance and a more piercing trajectory thanks to its deeper RKT Face technology. Adjustable Sole Weights in the front and rear allow you to optimize your preferred spin characteristics.

settings.heading: ZXi RKT Driver
settings.text: The ZXi RKT Driver combines fast, forgiveness, and feel with high ball speed and high MOI, while keeping spin relatively low. Adjustable Sole Weights in the heel and toe can be calibrated to promote your preferred trajectory.

settings.heading: ZXi RKT MAX Driver
settings.text: The ZXi RKT MAX Driver is Srixon's highest MOI Driver to date, featuring heightened forgiveness in a sharp, high-performance profile. An Adjustable Sole Weight placed exclusively low in the rear allows you to choose your preferred swing weight and maximize ZXi RKT MAX's MOI benefits for total confidence on the tee box.
